case: transcripts, descriptive transcript, reduced-motion film variant, contrast, flash hook, no 'accessible' claim

checks.name: silent explanation
checks.expect: descriptive_transcript required with the reason 'a silent visual explanation still needs a textual description'

checks.name: descriptions are authored
checks.expect: status needs_authoring; missing lists each beat; no description is generated from pixels

checks.name: audio description track
checks.expect: audio_description_track required; capability delivery.audio_description_track is unavailable with its reason

checks.name: contrast
checks.expect: a ratio 4.54 met; b not_measured with a reason; thresholds come from configurable defaults with needs_validation true

checks.name: colour only
checks.expect: problem: told apart by colour alone

checks.name: reduced motion film
checks.expect: m1 and m2 replaced with named substitutes, m3 kept; story_changed false; distinct_from Studio's reduce-animation setting; needs a render and a flash screening

checks.name: flash hook
checks.setup: no series / a synthetic series alternating 0.1 and 0.9 every frame at 30 fps
checks.expect: no series: not_measured; alternating series: status risk with the worst second

checks.name: acceptance wording
checks.expect: acceptance() never returns an accessible claim; lists met, not_met, not_measured; needs_human_review true

checks.name: native controls
checks.expect: Plan 14 with the owner's approval: VoiceOver reads the delivery panel labels; every control reachable by keyboard (not run)
